notes.title: The Horrors of Hammer Of Pain: How to Handle Dangers and New Monsters
notes.content:
[h1]Surviving Among Dangerous Creatures: Flowers, Predators, and Monsters in Hammer Of Pain![/h1]

[h2]Treacherous Flowers[/h2]
The last time I saw them was on the walls and ceilings of caves, but that was a long time ago, and I'm not sure if they are still there. I've never encountered them directly, but it's said that these flowers are very dangerous and feed on the energy of the earth, which gives them considerable strength. Therefore, it's better to stay away from them or destroy them as soon as you spot them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/d625c66d5b2a43271dbdb672197014f733f01b1a.gif[/img]

[h2]Guardians of the Forest: How to Survive an Encounter with a Large Predator[/h2]
Sharp long fangs, massive bodies, terrifying sounds coming from every bush—of course, I'm talking about boars. They mainly live in forests, but that doesn't make them any less dangerous. Just my advice as someone who has seen quite a bit in Arcona and beyond: always stay alert, as at any moment, a huge boar might charge at you, forcing you to drop everything and fight, or run all the way to Riven.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/5c5e3dfe2b47984909d186f01f27a4d173ab4f7f.gif[/img]

[h2]A New Mob?[/h2]
The Spitter is a rather dangerous creature, posing a serious threat due to its acidic spits. At first glance, its attacks might not seem so frightening, but that's a misconception. The Spitter's acidic spits can cause significant damage, and their danger should not be underestimated. If you encounter a Spitter, be prepared for its attacks to become a real test for your life and health.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/a99f2d369231dce025ac890c15b107bc040cdb91.gif[/img]

[h2]How Dangerous Is It?[/h2]
However, defeating a Spitter isn't that difficult. Usually, a few precise hits are enough. The problem lies in the fact that Spitters are highly fast and agile, making them quite challenging targets. You'll need to be agile and persistent to successfully deal with this opponent. There are two types of Spitters—large and small. Despite the size differences, both types pose a serious threat, and you should be ready for either. However, with proper preparation and determination, you can definitely defeat these adversaries.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/f490e490d9722b674a4b90bd468a2626d4fbf833.gif[/img]

notes.title: Grappling Hook: New Heights and Opportunities in Hammer of Pain 🚀
notes.content:
[h1]Speed and Height: The Grappling Hook in Action![/h1]

[h2]New Mechanics![/h2]
Quack-Quack! Do you love speed and the feeling of flight? When the wind blows through your hair, and you fly, enjoying every second? Then we have great news for you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/f8a96cf3e3b828c13d21fa778230a8aa97b9f16e.gif[/img]

[h2]Nora has a grappling hook![/h2]
How can it help Nora? With the grappling hook, Nora can now jump across chasms and escape from mobs that are too tough for her. This not only adds dynamism to the game but also opens up new tactical possibilities. Imagine skillfully jumping over abysses, escaping dangers, and exploring hard-to-reach places!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/67881c3aa2efd2d0c94420161cc246228d129611.gif[/img]

[h2]Heights and Adventures: How the Grappling Hook Will Change Your Gameplay[/h2]
Imagine soaring over chasms, clinging to ledges, and swinging over pits. Feel the adrenaline when every jump becomes an exciting adventure. The grappling hook opens new horizons for you and makes exploring the game world even more thrilling. You will have to solve puzzles using this new mechanic and find creative ways to overcome obstacles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/74caf2d69c51b884a9d2cac126353e28364503b3.gif[/img]

[h2]Jump Higher: The Thrill of the Grappling Hook Awaits You![/h2]
We are confident that this new feature will bring you a lot of excitement and make the gameplay even more enjoyable. Ready for new heights? Try the grappling hook in action and share your impressions with us!

notes.title: Alaric and the Call of the Dark Forests: New Mobs and Summer Adventures
notes.content:
[h1] Summer Adventures with Alaric! ? [/h1]
Hello, friends! Summer is in full swing, and we're excited to share some news about our summer development! ? In this devlog, we'll tell you how the court healer Alaric will help you in heated battles with new enemies that have overrun our lands.
[url=https://linktr.ee/hammerofpain style=button]Social Media[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/298e983cc798ceb3b961109cbf5ce625911ed209.gif[/img]

[h2] What Awaits You Ahead? ? [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/3081dc9ce303a388a38611f28478c16683f01018.gif[/img]
Expect thrilling adventures under the summer sun, meet new allies, and battle dangerous mobs! We are also eager to hear your feedback and suggestions, so don't hesitate to leave comments and join our social media to stay updated on all the latest news and events. Enjoy the summer with us and get ready for new adventures! ?

[h2] Stone Magic: Secrets of Living Stone ? [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/f7598fae20b04bb70832799337e1a8b11f15517f.gif[/img]
Have you ever felt fear in your life? I`m sure you have! But what if I tell you that a mere pile of stones, sprinkled with a bit of magic, can make you gallop all the way to Riven? Some say it`s the result of experiments from days gone by, while others believe Mother Nature herself is trying to punish us. There are as many opinions on the cause as there are people. I will tell you this: if you see a golem, you`d better run!

[h2] Mysteries of Light: Journey through Mazes and Puzzles ? [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/650bfd2b2958eaf104fac02b6909aa4def108d68.gif[/img]
Now, you`ll need to solve clever puzzles using lasers, move boxes, and activate pressure plates to open hidden passages and tackle engaging challenges. You will also encounter puzzles where you`ll need to manipulate light, using torches to illuminate dark corners and activate magical mechanisms.

[h2] World of Riddles: Explore Walls and Tiles in Search of Exits ? [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/50a11440313527f100c252a9cca2a151c17d3659.gif[/img]
Solve wall puzzles with hidden tiles and navigate complex mazes to demonstrate your cleverness and attention to detail, uncovering all the secrets of our unique game world.

[h2] Puzzles and Adventures: Immerse Yourself in a World of Unique Challenges ? [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/8c69d7aa6216327e7b3f5d57e824676eb7a93e88.gif[/img]
These puzzles offer unique challenges that will provide you with many hours of engaging gameplay and allow you to dive deeper into the atmosphere of the game. Prepare for exciting adventures that will require not only strength but also wit!

notes.title: ⚔️Combat Mechanic PlayTests Here!⚔️
notes.content:
[h1]🚀 Playtest Our Revamped Combat Mechanics! 🚀[/h1]

Hey Warriors of "Hammer of Pain"! 🛡️🔥

We've been in the forge, hammering away at our combat system, and guess what? It's time for you to dive back into battle and test the [b]ALL-NEW[/b] combat mechanics that we've fine-tuned with love, sweat, and a bit of magic. 🪄✨
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/f255c6c678efb5433349a0057ae97441e5866e95.gif[/img]
[h2]What’s New? 🕹️[/h2]

From feedback to feature requests, we've listened to it all and made significant changes:
- **Enhanced Combat Fluidity**: Fight like water, striking with the grace of a stream and the impact of a tsunami! 🌊💥
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/4cde882532d94674a26687476d333ccd3cb4ff4d.gif[/img]
- **Dynamic Attack Patterns**: Each battle is a dance, and we're adding new moves to your repertoire. 💃🕺
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/b998abb7cf81b9b7d24d60148875fd45777775e1.gif[/img]
- **Strategic Depth**: More ways to plan, execute, and emerge victorious in every encounter. 🧠⚔️

[h3]How Can You Help? 🤔[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/63885f44a6fac1d19f89fcfebbe7bbe99a6fe861.gif[/img]
Jump into the fray, push these new mechanics to their limits, and let us know your thoughts. Your feedback is the anvil upon which we forge the future of "Hammer of Pain".

[h2]Join the Playtest 🎮[/h2]

Ready to test your mettle? Here's how:
1. Head over to our Steam page and join the playtest. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438440/Hammer_of_Pain/]Join Now![/url]
2. After playing, don’t keep those thoughts bottled up! Share your feedback directly in our [url=https://discord.gg/pkUGbguVSZ]Discord[/url], or leave a comment on Steam.

[h3]Bonus: Join Our Community 🌟[/h3]

Not on our Discord yet? Now's the perfect time to join. It's the best place to discuss tactics, meet fellow warriors, and maybe drop a meme or two. 😉 [url=https://discord.gg/pkUGbguVSZ]Join the Discord![/url]

[h2]Thank You, Warriors! 🙏[/h2]

Your enthusiasm, feedback, and support fuel our journey. Together, we're making "Hammer of Pain" not just a game, but a saga written by its community!

[h1]🔥 Ready, Set, Battle! 🔥[/h1]

The arena is waiting, the swords are sharpened, and the magic is charged. Are you ready to rewrite the rules of combat in "Hammer of Pain"? See you on the battlefield!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/9c48732d9a1ed3e8b7bafaa1c7e34ec0dc2d3a5b.png[/img]

Remember, every strike, block, and spell cast brings us closer to the ultimate "Hammer of Pain" experience. Let's forge this legacy together! 🛠️❤️

notes.title: 📅 Summary of 2023 📅
notes.content:
[h1]📅Hammer of Pain - 2023 Year in Review📅[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/8bf24e5de8ed694f022b7fe9cbbda0406a363a6b.gif[/img]
Hello, everyone, SleepingFrog🐸 here! As the year is coming to an end, we wanted to share with you some of the highlights and achievements of this year, and thank you all for your amazing support and feedback. 🙏
[h2]✅We launched our Demo on Steam✅[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/42c084ebabe9ee324575cf120a5a8185c71b9de4.gif[/img]
One of the biggest milestones of this year was launching our demo on Steam this summer. This was a huge step for us, as it allowed us to showcase our game to a wider audience and get valuable feedback from you, the players. We were blown away by the positive response and the number of downloads we received. As of today, we have reached thousands of players who have tried our demo, and we are very grateful for that. 🙌
[h2]✅We updated and improved our demo✅[/h2]
Based on your feedback and suggestions, we have been working hard to update and improve our game throughout that time 👨🏻‍💻. We have added new features, fixed bugs, balanced the difficulty, and polished the graphics and sound. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/6e324d3a75263778e65a10373c0be747b5bf7ed2.gif[/img]
[h2]✅We made progress on the full game✅[/h2]
Besides working on the demo, we have also been making progress on the full game⚙️. We have been designing and developing new levels, enemies, weapons, and mechanics that will make the game more diverse and challenging. We have also been working on the story and the lore of the game world, which will add more depth and immersion to the game 🤗. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/df70ded145fbd73bb455a8b7e342688d3cd183a4.gif[/img]
[h2]❗We need your help❗[/h2]
As we are approaching the final stages of development, we need your help more than ever🤝. We want to make Hammer of Pain the best game it can be, and for that we need your feedback and suggestions. If you have played our demo, please leave a review on our social media and let us know what you liked and what you didn’t. If you haven’t played our demo yet, please give it a try and see for yourself what Hammer of Pain is all about▶️. You can download it for free from our Steam page📥:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438440/Hammer_of_Pain/ style=button]Download Hammer of Pain Demo[/url]
[h2]🎉We wish you a happy holiday season🎉[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/684493dfe6d05c3049a1542e53cff9ce173804b7.gif[/img]
Finally, we want to wish you all a very happy holiday season and a wonderful New Year🎇. We hope you enjoy playing our game and have a lot of fun. We also hope you stay safe and healthy in these difficult times🙏. We appreciate your support and we look forward to bringing you more Hammer of Pain in 2024. Thank you for being part of our journey. 🎄

notes.title: Discover Nora: The Heart of Adventure in Hammer of Pain
notes.content:
[h1] Unveiling Nora: The Soul of 'Hammer of Pain' [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/0a05ef87af9fb50ffa9ac931ea56346468352da7.png[/img]

Step into the mystical world of 'Hammer of Pain' and meet Nora, a character woven from the threads of mystery and adventure. Silver's daughter, a hunter with a story, she is more than just a character - she's a narrative brought to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/5a0c52352350ec1700df3e716281cc50ead9f5a9.gif[/img]

[h2] The Artistic Odyssey of Creating Nora [/h2]

Embark on a journey through the intricate art of [b]pixel animation[/b]. To bring Nora to life, our artists crafted over 360 separate images, each a pixelated brushstroke adding depth and motion to her character. Witness the meticulous process, where every frame is a canvas of creativity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/3ee4fc336734832d0be2ccba066052a3eab805b1.png[/img]

[h3] Nora: A Tapestry of Intrigue and Skill [/h3]

Nora, at her young age of 15, is not merely a hunter; she is a story personified. A blend of youthful vigor and ancient wisdom, her tale is a captivating one. What secrets does she harbor? What drives her through the untamed wilds of our game's world?

[expand type=details] Wanna know more about lore and Nora? Write about it in a comments![/expand]

[h2] Step into Nora's World: An Unparalleled Adventure Awaits [/h2]

Prepare to inhabit Nora's world and experience Hammer of Pain like never before:

[list]
    [*] [b]Mastery of Time[/b]: Engage in the mesmerizing ability to slow down time, turning battles into strategic masterpieces.
    [*] [b]The Archer's Craft[/b]: Harness the precision and grace of Nora's bow, a weapon that tells a story with every arrow shot.
    [*] [b]A Living Story[/b]: Immerse yourself in an evolving narrative, richly interlaced with the overarching lore of the game.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

The journey with Nora is not just about playing a character; it's about experiencing a world through her eyes. Are you ready to uncover the layers of mystery that surround her? Will her unique abilities guide you to untold stories within the realms of Hammer of Pain?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438440/Hammer_of_Pain/ style=button] Embark with Nora in Hammer of Pain [/url]

Keep your senses sharp and stay with us for more revelations and deep dives into the lore and characters of Hammer of Pain. The story of Nora is just a glimpse into the vast universe awaiting you.

[h1] A Heartfelt Thanks to Our Adventurers [/h1]

Your journey in Hammer of Pain is more than a game; it's an exploration into a world of wonder and intrigue. We await eagerly to share more tales and updates. The saga of Nora and the mysteries she holds are ready for you to unravel.
